en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small European town street or station area. In the foreground is an unpaved, wide road; behind a hedge line stand several late‑19th‑century buildings, two stories high, with arched windows and simple ornamentation. A lamppost and a small kiosk or shelter are visible near the center-right, with a man standing nearby and a cart beside one of the buildings. On the far left, the facade of a larger building has partially visible German text near the roofline. At the bottom border of the image there is handwriting or numbering that appears mirrored, likely from the negative.
